scope: The surviving gaol complex at Inchicore Road, including the original west range, Victorian east range, main entrance and governor’s front court, and high limestone enclosure around the Stonebreakers’ Yard.

originalReview.notes: Exact story photograph of the Stonebreakers’ Yard, including stone fabric, blocked arch, gate, and ground memorial. First Commons transfer records the original photographer’s own-work public-domain dedication and 2006 upload.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with the story’s exact native public-domain Stonebreakers’ Yard photograph. Exterior measurements and the sequence of additions come from published project records and current map geometry.
